dog.description_text:
My foster writes: Meet Lovely - a sweet girl with a big heart and lots of love to give! â¤ï¸
Lovely is a beautiful, affectionate, and curious girl who absolutely adores people! She can't get enough belly rubs, cuddles, and attention, and genuinely appreciates every bit of love she receives. She loves playing with toys and is incredibly gentle when taking treats.
Since arriving in foster care, Lovely has been discovering the joys of home life. She especially loves spending time in the backyard, where her playful, goofy personality really shines!
Lovely is also a wonderful houseguest! She's fully housebroken, crate-trained, and non-destructive at home. She's quiet, doesn't bark, and can comfortably spend time alone. She has a lovely balance of being calm and well-behaved indoors while showing her playful, adventurous side outside.
She's also incredibly smart and eager to learn! She loves hearing the word "come" and responds instantly when called at home. In less than a week, she's already learned to sit and stay! She's a quick learner who enjoys connecting with people and responds beautifully to attention and positive guidance.
Lovely is an enthusiastic explorer who gets very excited about squirrels and other dogs, so she's still working on her leash manners and learning to redirect her attention. She would thrive with a patient adopter who can provide consistent guidance, playtime, and plenty of affection.
What makes Lovely truly special is how much she appreciates love and attention. Whether she's enjoying a belly rub, playing with her toys, or simply soaking up affection, she's a wonderfully sweet girl who seems genuinely grateful for every moment of kindness.
Lovely has so much love to give and is ready to share it with someone special.
dog.name: Lovely
